posts.text: Day 1: VBC covered the Kessa–North highway opening; Kito TV aired the first debate. Both are worth checking against the primary sources, not just summaries. Debate transcripts and the official costings are public, so read them yourself before forming a view. #VeloriaVotes
Highway opening on VBC, rally crowd in the Ledger, debate on Kito. Two weeks left and everyone wants to tell me what they saw. Will read the costings before I decide anything.
Watched the debate. Arden talked jobs, Ostrand talked inflation. My diesel and fertiliser bills don't care about either speech. Who's going to bring them down? Asking honestly.

Took a fare up to the new Kessa–North highway this morning. Smooth as butter, no potholes, and my fuel bill is already feeling lighter. Good start, Ostrand. Let's see if the rest of the roads keep up 🚕

Read the Kito debate transcript twice. Ostrand's inflation numbers and Arden's 200,000 jobs both deserve the same question: what's the costing, and when does it arrive? Neither answered fully. Curious what others made of it.

Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it 'a new era.' Arden promises 200k jobs and gets asked how he'll pay for them. Two weeks out and I still have no idea what either of them would actually do. Wake me up when someone shows receipts.

Watched the debate last night. Arden put numbers on the table, Ostrand kept saying 'trust the record.' I work double shifts at St. Anne's, so I want to hear the costings before I trust anyone's promises. Both sides, show your math.

Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Roads like that mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck. Good sign. Still want to hear both candidates answer the costings question properly. Measure twice, cut once. #Veloria

Day 2 check: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' claim cherry-picks a peak month. Economists also flag a ~2% of GDP gap in his costings. Read the fact-check and the costings yourself before deciding. #VeloriaVotes

Read the VeriCheck piece on Arden's plan before forming a view. The 'doubles VAT' claim is false, but the economists' ~2% of GDP gap is the number I want both camps to explain. Costings are public. Go read them.

Two weeks out and fuel is still eating my margins. Diesel, fertiliser, all of it. Ostrand's highway is nice, but my tractor doesn't drive on it. Show me the numbers on what you'll do about input costs, both of you.

Two weeks out and I'm still waiting for the costings to line up. Arden's 200k jobs, Ostrand's highway 'new era': neither of them has shown the math on the St. Anne's staffing gap. Post the numbers, then we'll talk. #VeloriaVotes

Checked VeriCheck's notes on Arden's plan. VAT doubling: false, good. But the 2% of GDP gap is the number that matters, and it's worth asking both camps how they'd close theirs. Costings first, slogans second. #VeloriaVotes
Vat claim going around from the Unity Party page. Before I share anything, I want to see the actual costing document, not a screenshot. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks out and both camps are still doing the 'trust me' routine. Ostrand: 'trust the record.' Arden: '200k jobs!' Cool. Costings, timelines, who pays? Show receipts or stop asking me to vibe with you. #VeloriaVotes
Okay, I'll say it: the Kessa–North highway is GOOD. Smoothest ride I've had in years, and my fuel bill finally feels a bit lighter. Now the rest of the roads, please 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 3: VBC aired a 'questions raised' segment on a recording it says features Arden. The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before anyone shares the clip, check whether there's an authenticity analysis or chain-of-custody info, and note who's pushing it. Verify first. #VeloriaVotes

Watched the VBC clip on the Arden recording. Says 'questions raised' but I didn't hear who verified the audio or where it came from. Anyone have the source or a forensic check? Not defending anyone, just asking before I form a view. #VeloriaVotes

Watched the VBC clip twice. Doesn't matter who's in it, I want the full unedited file and a chain of custody before I believe a word. Same goes for the 'AI fake' denial. Show me the original, both sides. #VeloriaVotes

That leaked audio is going round the WhatsApp groups with 'forward before it's deleted!!' written all over it. Before I share anything, I want to know where it came from and whether anyone has checked it. Same goes for the VBC clip. Not forwarding until I know. #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks out and the leaked audio clip is everywhere, but nobody's checked it against the source. VBC says 'questions raised', Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before forwarding anything, wait for a forensic check. Would rather see the costings than a clip. #VeloriaVotes

Watched the VBC clip on the Arden 'recording' twice. Authenticity is still unverified, and I'd want an independent forensic check before anyone treats it as proof of anything. Same standard for Ostrand's record: show me the audit trail. #VeloriaVotes

A VBC 'questions raised' clip with no source, no chain of custody, and a 'the Civic Front says it's fake' line. Before anyone's outraged or relieved, where did the recording come from and who has verified it? Two weeks out, show receipts from BOTH sides. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 check: the 'Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port' claim is from Veloria Patriots Daily. Before sharing, look for the source document or any VeriCheck review. Kito's poll (Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ±3) is a statistical tie, so treat it as one. #VeloriaVotes

Read the Ledger's 'road funds' exclusive and the ministry's 'fabricated' reply side by side. Documents can be real or doctored, so before anyone treats this as proven, ask: who holds the originals, and has anyone independent examined them? Same standard for Kito's 46-44: that's inside the ±3 margin, so nobody is ahead yet. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Within the margin of error either way. Fine, but my diesel bill doesn't care about a poll. Still waiting for someone to say what they'll actually do on input costs. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Within the margin of error, so nobody's winning yet. Still waiting on the St. Anne's staffing numbers from either side. 9 days to go. #VeloriaVotes
Kito poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a coin flip with a margin of error on top. Still nobody's shown the costings, so I'm not switching cabs on a poll. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Ledger's 'road funds diverted to a relative's firm' story: the ministry says fabricated. Before I believe either side, I want the documents, the firm's registration, and who the relative is. Anyone checked the source yet? #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Before it moves anyone, I want the costings from both camps, not another poll. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Veloria Patriots Daily: 'Arden's running mate has a foreign passport, will sell the port!!' Cool, cool. Where's the source, the registry, the actual document? Breaking news with zero receipts is just vibes in a trench coat. Verify before you rage, people. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded 'community ambassador' pay: 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity, via a bot link. Who's paying, and is this disclosed anywhere? Don't sign up for cash to push votes without knowing. Check the source first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5: The commission is publishing its results-transmission procedure (scanned forms uploaded to VeloResults) and inviting observers to a system test. Good. Go read the procedure before the next wild claim about 'rigged' tallies. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs tags are both trending, and researchers say dozens of accounts behind each were made this month and posted near-identical text within minutes. Who's astroturfing this, and who's paying? Show receipts before I vibe with either side. #VeloriaVotes

Ok so the WhatsApp 'community ambassador' thing paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Pay people to convince others? Sounds like a pyramid or a bot farm, not a campaign. Anyone checked the bot link? 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Checked the VeroResults procedure the commission just published: forms get scanned and uploaded to the public portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Whatever side you're on, go watch the test and read the forms yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the commission just published how results get transmitted: scanned polling-station forms uploaded to VeloResults, observers invited to a system test. Good. Show me the system test results, not just the press release. Costings too. #VeloriaVotes

Diesel up again and nobody's said a word about input costs. Ostrand's highway is nice, my tractor doesn't drive on it. Arden, show me the fertiliser plan, not the jobs number. Still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Read the commission's notice on VeloResults twice. Forms scanned and uploaded publicly, observers invited to test it. That's how you earn trust: show the process, not just the slogans. Both camps should welcome scrutiny of the vote itself. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing the town name is getting passed around. A slip is a slip. Still waiting on the costings from both camps, which matter more than one bad syllable. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and the 212 polling stations 'moving for security' letter is going round WhatsApp with no source attached. Before anyone panics or shares, check IECV's own site and the official notice. Show me the letter from the commission, not a forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. The 212 Northern Province polling stations 'moving for security' letter is going round WhatsApp with 'check before you go!' on it. Before anyone panics or relaxes, check it on the IECV site. Official notices get posted there. Still waiting on the St. Anne's staffing numbers too. #VeloriaVotes

Kito clip of the President's slip on that town name: a stumble is a stumble, not a policy. Let's keep the attention on the costings both camps still haven't shown. Who closes the 2% gap? #VeloriaVotes

IECV letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before forwarding, check the official IECV site and the station list yourself. Don't rely on a WhatsApp copy. Verify first, then tell your neighbours. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town going around. Her team says 'slip of the tongue.' Fair enough, a gaffe is a gaffe. Not a policy issue. Let's keep the focus on costings and the VeroResults test. #VeloriaVotes

The WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before I forward it to anyone: who signed it, and is it on the commission's site? Check VeloResults or the IECV page first. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

President Ostrand says 'a slip of the tongue' about mangling a town name on Kito TV. Cool, cool. Every politician has a bad pronunciation day. Less cool is that nobody's talking about the costings yet. Show receipts from BOTH sides before I vibe with either. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Campaign silence starts tonight and Zuri K is out here dropping an endorsement video anyway. Cool, cool. Silence means silence, right? Or is that just a suggestion now? Show me the rules being followed before I vibe with anyone. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: Campaign silence starts tonight. Tip for everyone: don't share results-night screenshots from random accounts. Wait for IECV/VeloResults. Post the scanned forms, not the hot takes. #VeloriaVotes

Campaign silence starts tonight, and the Civic Front voice note telling people to 'stay home, we have it covered' is exactly the kind of message to check before forwarding. Nurses don't pick shifts from voice notes. Read the IECV notice yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Campaign silence starts tonight, and the 'stay home, we have it covered' voice note going round WhatsApp is exactly what to check before you act on it. Who sent it, and does it match the commission's official notice? Vote your own conscience, not a forward. #VeloriaVotes
Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Good time to stop reacting to clips and read the actual costings from both camps before polls close. Verify the stuff you're about to forward. #VeloriaVotes

Campaign silence starts tonight and the WhatsApp voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Who's sending that, and why would a candidate tell people not to vote? Check IECV's official notice before you forward it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The WhatsApp voice note saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is exactly the kind of message to check before you act on it. Who sent it, and is it from Arden's team? Go vote like it's your choice. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province and officials switched to the printed register, as the law allows. If you're in the North, bring your ID and check the IECV site for your station. Verify before you share. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the commission says turnout is high. Some ID kits failed up north, and they switched to the printed register like the law allows. Go to your station, vote, then check IECV for updates instead of WhatsApp photos. Staff at my ward will be on shift all day. #VeloriaVotes

Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. Some ID kits failed in the north and officials switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Read the commission's notices and VeloResults directly before believing any claim about the count. Let the process speak. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. The IECV says polls are open and some Northern kits failed, so they switched to the printed register like the law allows. Don't trust the 'ballot boxes pre-stuffed' photo until the commission or a verified observer confirms it. Check IECV and VeroResults before you forward. Then go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the Commission says 212 Northern stations are 'moving for security' 🙄 Cool, cool. Before anyone panics or stays home, check the IECV site. Official notices get posted there, not in WhatsApp voice notes. Vote your conscience, not a forward. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria 🚕 Polls are open. Before you forward ANY photo of 'pre-stuffed' ballot boxes or 'OFFICIAL' letters, check IECV and VeloResults. If it's not on the commission's site, it's not verified. Go vote, then check the forms yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the 'stay home, we have it covered' voice note is still floating around. Check IECV's official notice before you act on any voice note. Polls are open. Go vote, then check the official results on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, 30% and 25% of stations, and they disagree by 6 points in opposite directions. Different stations counted first, so neither means much yet. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms. Don't screenshot random 'FINAL' posts. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and we've got two 'tallies' that disagree, plus an unverified account posting 'FINAL RESULTS' before the count is even done. 🙄 Cool, cool. Nobody post a number until IECV/VeroResults publishes the scanned forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, two different answers: Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. They each counted different stations first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for VeroResults and the scanned forms. Cab's parked till the official count is posted. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, different station samples, 30% and 25% counted, and they point opposite ways. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms before you screenshot anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9: Kito TV and VBC are showing opposite leads from partial tallies (Arden 51-47 vs Ostrand 53-45), and they're counting different stations first, so neither means much yet. Wait for VeroResults and the IECV scanned forms before anyone calls it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV's tally (51-47 Arden, 30% of stations) and VBC's (53-45 Ostrand, 25%) disagree, but they counted different stations first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms before anyone declares anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and two tallies, 30% and 25% of stations, pointing opposite ways. Each counts different stations first, so neither proves anything yet. Wait for VeroResults with the scanned forms. Don't trust the first screenshot, mine included. #VeloriaVotes

Two tallies, two different winners, and Civic Front already declaring victory from 'party agent tallies'. Both TV counts are partial. Nobody concedes on that. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults, then talk. Ostrand's fuel prices still hurt my farm though. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The IECV says 41% of station forms are up on VeloResults and the rest are being collated by hand, so the delay is slow, not a sign of a fix. Two partial TV tallies still tell us nothing. Wait for the scanned forms before any number gets called. Patience is what keeps a count honest. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10: The IECV says 41% of station forms are online and results are still being collated manually. The 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' claim is FALSE per VeriCheck, since the portal can't show province winners. Don't share it. Wait for the scanned forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and the Patriots Daily page says 'the portal PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' 🙄 Cool, cool. 41% of forms are online and the IECV is still collating by hand. Nobody gets a winner from a screenshot. Wait for the scanned forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 🚕 IECV says 41% of station forms are up on VeloResults, the rest are delayed by a 'technical glitch' and being collated by hand. Slow is annoying, but it's not a result. Wait for the scanned forms before anyone calls it. Cab's still parked. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeroResults is still stuck at 41% of forms online. Glitches happen, but the scanned forms are the only thing I'm waiting for. Got a St. Anne's shift at 7, so I'll check the IECV page on my break. Not reposting any tallies until it's posted. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeroResults has 41% of station forms up, and VeriCheck confirms there's no province-level winner yet, so the '9 of 14' claim doesn't hold. The glitch is an argument for patience and for publishing every scan, from either camp. Wait for the full set. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeroResults is only 41% up. Glitch or not, nobody gets to call it until the scanned forms are online. Two partial tallies pointing opposite ways means nothing yet. Show me the forms, not the screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The portal only has 41% of forms up, so the '9 of 14' line can't be checked yet. Neither can anyone's lead. Wait for the scanned forms and the province tallies before you believe a number, mine included. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official result, from the commission. Thank you to every poll worker and observer who stayed to count. Now let's keep the peace. Patience got us here. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 🚕 IECV has officially declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Congrats to the winner, and respect to Arden's supporters for waiting for the forms. Now the real work: check the scanned forms on VeroResults and keep the peace. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Declared by the commission, so that's the count for now. Scanned forms are the only thing I'll trust past this, and I'll read them before saying anything more. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission says voting was orderly but flags skewed state coverage and transmission delays. Those are real concerns to press for, and the scanned forms should back up the margin. Publish every station form, and let the numbers be checked from either side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. The regional observer mission calls voting largely peaceful and orderly but flags skewed state-broadcaster coverage and transmission delays. Read the full statement on IECV before drawing conclusions. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Margin's narrow and a lot of us are exhausted. Read the scanned forms on VeroResults before you argue about it, and let's keep the comments civil. Back to my shift. #VeloriaVotes

Results are out and Civic Front says the servers were hacked. Show me the scanned forms on VeroResults before anyone says 'stolen'. I'm not saying Ostrand's fuel prices don't hurt, they do, but I want proof either way. Take it to court with paper, not screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the IECV finally declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result, from the commission's own site. Cool, cool. Now the scanned forms should be up on VeroResults so anyone can check the math. Losers can still challenge through the courts, that's how it's supposed to work. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. That's the kind of check that makes a result stick. Whatever the logs show, I want to read them, not a headline about them. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito reports the Civic Front petition and the Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. That's the process working. Whatever the logs show, both sides get to check the same data. Whatever side you're on, that's the outcome to want. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12: Kito TV reports the Supreme Court has ordered the commission to give both sides supervised access to servers and logs. VBC's 'riot in Kessa' clip shows burning tyres, but no date or place I can verify yet. Check the court order and the commission's log access before believing either story. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 🚕 Kito TV says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the servers and logs for BOTH sides. Good. That's how you settle it. Stop reposting VBC footage and Valdoria hot takes, check the scanned forms on VeroResults yourself. Cab's still parked. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and the court has ordered supervised access to the servers and logs for both sides. That's the right call. Show me the scanned forms on VeroResults and let the audit do its job. Ostrand's fuel prices are still killing my margins, but I'll wait for paper, not screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it 'riots'. Kito TV reports the petition and the Supreme Court order for supervised server access. Footage with no date or place isn't proof of anything. The court order is the thing to watch. Let the audit happen. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and the Supreme Court just ordered supervised access to the IECV servers and logs for BOTH sides 👀 Good. That's what 'wait for the forms' was always about. Nobody gets to say 'stolen' or 'landslide' until the logs are checked. Let the lawyers do their thing. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs, and VBC is showing burning tyres in Kessa and calling it 'calm restored'. I don't know yet what happened in Kessa. Waiting for the court process and the IECV statement before I believe either side. Shift at 7, checking VeroResults on break. #VeloriaVotes
